Le jeu de frappe spatial : des mots trav: The space typing game: words fly across the screen, type them before they reach your rocket. Five difficulty levels, combos, golden words and power-ups, game modifiers, a tutorial and a game guide. Fight the NEXUS-7 boss in keyboard duels, discover the story, and level up to unlock rocket skins, cursors, themes, typing sounds and 94 achievements. Profile, records and history of your games; 16 fonts and 4 languages (French, English, Spanish, German).
Niveau, succès, records, réglages et his: Level, achievements, records, settings and game history.
